description: This file defines a class ValidateResponseChecksumParser which decorates a parser for AWS S3 responses to validate the checksum of the response for data integrity checks. It includes methods for parsing, checksum validation, and selecting the appropriate checksum header.

classes.name: ValidateResponseChecksumParser
classes.description: A class that wraps an existing parser to add checksum validation logic for AWS S3 responses, ensuring data integrity based on response headers and user configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with a wrapped parser and the AWS service API.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Processes the response with the wrapped parser, then performs checksum validation if applicable, throwing an exception on failure.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Delegates parsing of a response member from a stream to the underlying parser.

methods.name: validateChecksum
methods.description: Validates the checksum header value against a calculated checksum from the response body.

methods.name: chooseChecksumHeaderToValidate
methods.description: Selects the highest priority checksum header present in the response for validation.
